method.execution_constraints: No extensions, MCP, global skill/context injection or write-capable tools; source-only reads. This is a tool-restricted test, not an OS filesystem sandbox.
method.scoring: Coordinator read each actual final response and inspected calls, then recorded criterion-level verbatim evidence; code checks bindings and excerpts but does not determine semantic pass.
method.reviewer_independence: Reviewer is separate from isolated case executors, but is the same coordinating assistant that edited the package; not a blinded independent expert panel.
method.repetition: One sample per case per round; source-aware constrained cases, not end-to-end task-discovery, held-out generalization or a multi-model benchmark.
method.source_versions: 16 retained round-2 cases plus the two cases that actually read the changed crowd owner/template, rerun on final runtime bytes. Not represented as an all-18 same-snapshot rerun.
